column1: # Words dropped entirely from the generated lexicon (never reach LexiqueMixte.tsv /
# Dictionary at all) -- unlike resources/ambiguityIgnoreList.tsv, which only affects
# the ambiguity *metric* and leaves the word typable. Historically these lived as
# two hardcoded Python lists in lexique.py (`problemList`, `foreignList`, no
# per-word reason recorded anywhere) -- moved here 2026-09-18 for consistency with
# the rest of this project's tsv-based exception tables (reform1990.tsv,
#   word    -- the corpus `ortho` string to exclude (exact match)
#                foreign_word       -- a loanword/foreign term, generally excluded
#                unsupported_phoneme -- confirmed to use a phoneme outside the
#                unpopular_spelling -- a misspelling or much-rarer variant of a
#                                      word already present under its normal
#                                      form, an odd derived-noun entry, etc.)
#   note    -- short justification; "unverified legacy entry" where the original
#              per-word reasoning was never recorded and hasn't been re-derived
# `reason` here is a best-effort reconstruction from the word list alone (the
# original lists predate any commit message explaining individual entries) --
# treat as provisional, not authoritative; happy to be corrected per-word.
